as_written_in_papers.quote: Three of these variants (c.487-1G\>A, c.805+1G\>A, and c.986+1G\>T) were introduced into WTex3-8, and the other (c.2088+1G\>A) into WTex7-9.

cases.statement: One affected heterozygous female (P50, family F33) in the Japanese national survey. A probably-identical patient in 36211342 is reported with a different nucleotide (c.986+1G>T); see concerns.

people.label: P50 (family F33)
people.zygosity_or_genotype: heterozygous (cohort-level statement that all 54 patients were heterozygous)
people.key_phenotypes: onset 10 yr; SLE and Sjögren's syndrome, later TRAPS diagnosis; prolonged fever; oral and genital ulcers; erythema nodosum and photosensitivity; subacute necrotizing lymphadenitis; elevated IFN score

phenotype_specificity.statement: Cohort-level only: the survey enrolled patients whose HA20 diagnosis was confirmed by functional analysis; TNFAIP3 was Sanger-sequenced or tested on an autoinflammatory gene panel. Results for other genes in this person are not reported.

quotes.quote: The diagnosis of HA20 was confirmed via functional analysis of the TNFAIP3 variant.
Genomic DNA was extracted from peripheral blood for sequencing of all exons and exon-intron junctions of *TNFAIP3*.

Regarding recently identified cases, next-generation sequencing of target genes related to autoinflammatory disorders, including *TNFAIP3*, was performed at the Kazusa DNA Laboratory (Kisarazu, Japan).

segregation.statement: Not stated in the text (P50 is the only listed member of F33). Cohort-level penetrance figure only.

quotes.quote: Additionally, family analysis revealed that three cases with heterozygous variants were asymptomatic (penetrance: 95.7%).

functional.statement: Minigene splicing assay (construct, TNFAIP3 exons 3-8 in HEK293T; wild-type comparator): two products; the smaller showed partial deletion of exon 6 (c.925_986del; p.Ile310GlyfsX), the larger three partial intron 6 insertions (p.Lys329AsnfsX). The paper names the minigene variant both c.986+1G>C and c.986+1G>T. Separately, 36211342 reports an NF-κB reporter assay (HEK293T, wild-type comparator) confirming its variant p.Lys329Asn*1 (written there as c.986+1 G>T) — whether this is the same variant is unresolved.

quotes.quote: Two bands were detected on the 2% agarose gel electrophoresis of *TNFAIP3* cDNA derived from the c.986+1G\>C variant.
Direct sequencing of the smaller PCR product from the c.986+1G\>C minigene showed a partial deletion of exon 6 (c.925_986del; p.Ile310GlyfsX) (**Supplementary Figure 4D**).
Direct sequencing showed partial insertion of three patterns of intron 6 (insertion of g.10070_10164, g.10070_10218, and g.10070_10233; p.Lys329AsnfsX) (**Supplementary Figure 4D**).

Determination of the patients’ genotypes and TNFAIP3 variants revealed several previously reported variants (32) and as well as two variants (p.Lys329Asn*1 and p.Gly583*) newly confirmed to be pathogenic using a NF-κB reporter gene activity assay
Suppression of the TNF-α induced NF-κB activity by
the TNFAIP3 variants was significantly lower than that seen in the WT.

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Canonical splice-donor change at the exon 6 / intron 6 boundary (c.986+1G>C); predicted protein p.? in the batch. Disease mechanism as stated in the papers: heterozygous loss of function (haploinsufficiency).

quotes.quote: A20 haploinsufficiency (HA20) is a hereditary autoinflammatory disease caused by heterozygous loss-of-function variants in the TNFAIP3 gene (1).

authors_classification.statement: Cohort-level only: the authors describe all 35 distinct variants in the 54 surveyed patients with the words quoted. No per-variant ACMG criteria are stated.

quotes.quote: All 54 patients analyzed had heterozygous variants in TNFAIP3, comprising a total of 35 distinct pathogenic variants.

concerns: Nucleotide inconsistency: 40574834 writes c.986+1G>C in Supplementary Table 1, the pedigree and the minigene results, but c.986+1G>T in the minigene methods. 36211342 patient 1 is written c.986+1 G>T, p.Lys329Asn*1.

Probable same person not in this batch's rows: 36211342 Table S2 patient 1 (female, SLE with recurrent fever, lymphadenitis and arthritis, prednisolone and hydroxychloroquine, IFN score 40.3) matches 40574834 P50 (female, SLE, lymphadenitis, PSL and HDQ, IFN score cited to reference 4 = 36211342). But onset differs (infancy vs 10 yr) and the nucleotide differs (G>T vs G>C). The panel should decide whether this is one variant mis-typed in one place.
protein_check differs: the paper's protein (p.Ile310GlyfsX2 in the pedigree) is one of two minigene outcomes; 36211342 gives p.Lys329Asn*1 (the other outcome); the batch predicts p.?.
Cited prior report for P50 is reference 4 (= 36211342, in batch).
notes_for_panel: Single affected carrier with lupus-like and autoinflammatory features. Minigene shows two aberrant transcripts. Resolve the G>C vs G>T discrepancy before using 36211342's reporter result.
